summary: The PlacementRequestChanges class tracks changes made to placement requests such as urgent alerts, cancellations, date changes, destination changes, and supervisor changes. It provides a mechanism for destination coordinators to identify and analyze changes in placement request destinations.
purpose: To monitor and quantify the number of various changes to placement requests (urgent alerts, cancellations, date changes, destination changes, supervisor changes) within the system, enabling destination coordinators to review and respond to updates efficiently.

fields.name: UrgentAlerts
fields.purpose: Track the number of urgent alerts associated with placement requests.

fields.name: Cancellations
fields.purpose: Track the number of cancelled placement requests.

fields.name: DateChanges
fields.purpose: Track the number of changes to placement request dates.

fields.name: DestinationChanges
fields.purpose: Track the number of changes to placement request destinations.

fields.name: SupervisorChanges
fields.purpose: Track the number of changes to placement request supervisors.

business_rules: Counters for each change type must be incremented when a relevant change is detected.
validations: DataReader must be non-null before processing placement destinations.
calculations: UrgentAlerts are incremented when a change is detected during analysis.
